original.title: Build the textstats library and CLI
original.brief: Implement the self-contained contract in examples/textstats/CONTRACT.md. Library and CLI may be developed independently. All work is complete when both pass their tests and the coordinator verifies end-to-end behavior.

children.title: Implement and test Analyze
children.brief: Read CONTRACT.md. Implement package textstats Analyze and Stats in analyze.go; test empty input, Unicode whitespace, trailing newlines, CRLF and invalid UTF-8 in analyze_test.go. You own only these two files. After the core implementation is in place, supersede this task into a crisp remaining verification task, preserving the completed work in its brief.

children.title: Implement and test the textstats CLI
children.brief: Read CONTRACT.md. Implement cmd/textstats/main.go, cmd/textstats/main_test.go, and README.md. Use textstats.Analyze; the core agent is writing it concurrently. Test stdin, files, JSON, errors and exit codes. You own only these three files. Coordinate via taskctl if waiting on the core implementation.

review.title: Verify the integrated textstats project
review.brief: Once all replacements of the original build task are completed, inspect the combined source, run go test ./..., build the CLI and verify Unicode stdin plus file and error paths. Record final evidence and any tracker issues.
